title: Echo Loop
summary: A pattern memory loop where each echo sequence must be repeated in the correct order.
instructions: Repeat the shown pattern with 1, 2, 3, and 4.

overlay.startCopy: A memory loop challenge. Watch the four-pad sequence, then replay it cleanly before the loop resets.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Loop in the center overlay.
Watch the pad sequence as it lights up.
Use the menu to restart if you lose the pattern.
tips: Count the pattern in your head before replaying it.
Longer runs add more sequence pressure.

onboarding.title: Echo Setup
startSteps: Open Help to see the four input pads.
Press Start Loop to show the pattern.
Replay the pattern exactly once it finishes flashing.
onboarding.firstGoal: Repeat the opening pattern without breaking the sequence.
